WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{5}-[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN concat(substr(x.raw, 1, 5), '0', substr(x.raw, 7, 3), substr(x.raw, 11, 2)) WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{5}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1}$' THEN concat(substr(x.raw, 1, 5), substr(x.raw, 7, 4), '0', substr(x.raw, 12, 1)) WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{11}$' THEN x.raw WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' AND x.hits = 1 THEN coalesce(x.k442, x.k532, x.k541) ELSE '' END, '') AS ndc11, x.pkg_ndc AS ndc_as_recorded, x.descr AS description, CAST(round(x.on_hand_pkgs * coalesce(x.pkg_size, 1), 0) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS on_hand, CAST(x.daily_use_pkgs * coalesce(x.pkg_size, 1) AS DECIMAL(14,3)) AS daily_use, coalesce(lower(trim(x.uom)), '') AS unit, CAST(coalesce(x.pkg_size, 1) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS pkg_units, concat('packages of ', coalesce(x.pkg_size, 1), ', converted to units') AS unit_basis, CASE WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{4,5}-[0-9]{3,4}-[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN 'dashed 10-digit, converted' WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{11}$' THEN '11-digit as recorded' WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' AND x.hits = 1 THEN concat('repaired: undashed, only the ', CASE WHEN x.k442 IS NOT NULL THEN '4-4-2' WHEN x.k532 IS NOT NULL THEN '5-3-2' ELSE '5-4-1' END, ' reading is in FDA') WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' AND x.hits = 0 THEN 'undashed, no reading is in FDA' WHEN x.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' THEN concat('ambiguous: undashed, ', x.hits, ' readings are in FDA') WHEN x.raw = '' THEN 'blank in source' ELSE 'unrecognised format' END AS ndc_match FROM (SELECT r.*, a.k AS k442, b.k AS k532, d.k AS k541, CASE WHEN a.k IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN b.k IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN d.k IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS hits FROM (SELECT e.*, trim(coalesce(e.pkg_ndc, '')) AS raw FROM corvale_east.stock_position e) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ndc11 AS k FROM fda.ndc_packages) a ON r.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' AND a.k = concat('0', r.raw) LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ndc11 AS k FROM fda.ndc_packages) b ON r.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' AND b.k = concat(substr(r.raw, 1, 5), '0', substr(r.raw, 6, 5)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ndc11 AS k FROM fda.ndc_packages) d ON r.raw RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$' AND d.k = concat(substr(r.raw, 1, 9), '0', substr(r.raw, 10, 1))) x
